context: A uni student teases his teen friend at the cafe
purpose: Teach: 人格/一見/ツッコミ/あぁ/何処/とかいう/しょうが/未だに

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一見すると優等生っぽいのに、お前って意外と抜けてるよな。
lines.en: At first glance you look like an honor student, but you're surprisingly clumsy.
lines.style: Teasing senior tone, casual and slightly amused delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、いきなり何処からそんな話になるんですか？
lines.en: Hey, where on earth is this conversation suddenly coming from?
lines.style: Mock-offended teen voice with a rising indignant pitch.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いやだって、さくらって人格が二つあるんじゃないかってくらい学校と外で違うじゃん。
lines.en: I mean, you act so differently at school and outside it's like you have two personalities.
lines.style: Playful jab with a drawn-out casual delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あぁ、もう、毎回そういうツッコミやめてくださいよ先輩。
lines.en: Ugh, seriously, please stop with those jabs every single time, senpai.
lines.style: Whiny exasperation while slumping into the seat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 未だに敬語なのも逆に怪しいんだよなぁ、本性隠してる感じで。
lines.en: The fact you still use polite speech is suspicious too, like you're hiding your true self.
lines.style: Sly grin paired with a teasing accusation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しょうがないじゃないですか、年上なんだから当然でしょ。
lines.en: Well it can't be helped, you're older than me, of course I would.
lines.style: Pouting defense delivered with arms crossed tightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほら、その口調、なんとかいう演技派女優みたいでわざとらしいって。
lines.en: See, that tone, it's theatrical like some so-called method actress.
lines.style: Laughing while pointing a finger accusingly at her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もう、絶対に先輩とは二度とカフェ来ませんからね！
lines.en: Ugh, I am absolutely never coming to a cafe with you again!
lines.style: Fake-angry huff while trying to hide a smile.
